value.rationale: The natural abelian-two-plane moduli scheme of a standard nonreductive Lie algebra admits a complete normality, singular-locus and resolution description, with arithmetic zeta function. These structural results do not follow merely from invariant-ring information and distinguish singular compactification from smooth open bundle.
